subject: hallmark/symbol.svg

checks.label: symbol: Clean vector master
checks.message: Pure vector, self-contained, scalable.

checks.label: symbol: Legibility at 16 px
checks.message: 89% of the shape survives at 16 px (≥ 85% reads clearly).

checks.label: symbol: Legibility at 32 px
checks.message: 89% of the shape survives at 32 px (≥ 85% reads clearly).

checks.label: symbol: Thinnest detail at 16 px
checks.message: Thin strokes/gaps are ~1 px wide at 16 px (≥ 1.2 px stays crisp).

checks.label: symbol: Optical balance
checks.message: Visual centroid sits 2% from center, slightly high, which reads as optically centered.

checks.label: symbol: Artboard fit
checks.message: Mark spans 82% of the artboard (80–98% keeps icon exports consistent).

checks.label: symbol: Fits a square icon
checks.message: The mark is 1.17:1 and fills a square icon well.

checks.label: symbol: Distinct from stock primitives
checks.message: Closest stock shape is a rounded square at 38% overlap.

checks.label: symbol: Construction complexity
checks.message: 2 paths, 41 path commands, compactness 9.9.

checks.label: symbol: One-color reproduction
checks.message: Shapes stay separable in a single color.

checks.label: symbol: Visible on its paper (#F2ECE1)
checks.message: Reads on its own background (strongest color ≥ 3:1).

checks.label: symbol: Contrast of #16120f
checks.message: Works on light grounds; use a reversed variant on the other.

checks.label: symbol: Contrast of #7e1d2a
checks.message: Works on light grounds; use a reversed variant on the other.

checks.label: symbol: Palette separation
checks.message: Closest pair of colors differs by ΔE₀₀ 27.46. Under 20, shapes separated only by these colors blur together for many viewers; vary lightness too.

checks.label: symbol: Lightness contrast inside the mark
checks.message: Lightness difference between brand colors (matters for grayscale print and color-vision deficiencies).
